_meta.name: Booking order (October 2026)
_meta.purpose: The order the injected booking instruction sets: the appointment first (day, then time), then the name, then the mobile number, one thing per message. Scored on its own: eval/cases.json is frozen.
_meta.written: Before the code it measures (2026-10-19). Every visitor turn and every needle is sliced from an existing case or from messages/ar.json, not typed.

cases.why: Nothing of the appointment is known: the bot asks for the day, and neither the name nor the number. Booking order: no name or number before the appointment is complete.
Name before mobile, and the mobile asked for by code: the time is held, the name has just come, the next and only question is the mobile number.
The whole order, one thing per message: time, then name, then mobile, then the booking.
A name volunteered before the appointment is kept: once the time is held, only the mobile number is asked for.
A number volunteered before the appointment is kept: once the time is held, only the name is asked for.
A one-word name volunteered before the appointment is not asked about yet: the full name is asked for at the name step, not before the day and time.
The one-word name is kept, asked about once at the name step, and accepted flagged: the booking goes through.
The model is no longer told to restate earlier parts: the day from one message and the hour from the next still make the appointment (the draft holds the day).
One thing per message: with nothing of the appointment known, the day is asked for, not the day and the hour together.
